agent_hint: POST /v1/recall_polygon collapses /v1/locate → polygon_sample_cells → /v1/recall_many into one call. The bbox source is declared so an agent can detect when the geocoder fell back from polygon (Nominatim bbox) to a single-cell centroid (place-name drift mitigation: fail loud, not silent). Set `cells_per_sqkm` for a uniform spatial resolution; set `drill_on_water: true` to find sub-stride water features.

copdem30m.elevation_mean.description: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM statistics at the cell: elevation mean, percentiles, slope, aspect (sin/cos), TRI roughness.
copdem30m.elevation_mean.interpretation: Default DEM source for emem — superior to SRTM at high latitudes and over dense canopy. Use for hydro-routing, viewshed, slope-stability, and sea-level-rise exposure.
copdem30m.elevation_mean.pitfalls: GLO-30 is a *surface* model (DSM): it includes building / canopy heights. Subtract `landcover.tree` × typical canopy height for a bare-earth approximation, or pull GLO-90 for a DTM-like product.

band_metadata_layout: hoisted: keyed by band; pass `verbose:true` to inline per-fact
next: Each cell.receipt is independently signed; verify any cell's receipt via POST /v1/verify_receipt.
For region statistics over the merged_facts, POST /v1/query_region with `geometry: "cells:c1,c2,..."` and the same bands.
If a sub-cell water body was missed (Katihar lesson), pass `cells_per_sqkm: 4.0` for ~500 m stride, or `drill_on_water: true` for a coarse-then-drill scan around recurrence-positive cells.
max_cells hard-cap is 1024 (raised May 2026); default stays 64.

retry.how: repeat the identical request; every retry returns strictly more from cache, because everything materialized persists
